name: Ember Camp

/* Ember Camp: a campfire in a pine clearing under the Milky Way (original illustration). The fire always burns in the free strip right of the conversation and flares while the agent works; dusk-blue glass panels, ember-orange accents, and a spark line over the composer that grows as the context fills. Dark only. */
